steps.instruction: Tap a holder to deploy its darts!
Well done! Watch the darts fly.
Pop all the balloons to clear the level!
Darts only pop balloons of the same color!
Tap the holder that matches the balloon colors.
Great! Now try the other holder.
Three colors now! Match each holder to its balloons.
Tap the red holder to clear red balloons.
Now pick the best holder to clear the board!
Watch out! If too many holders pile up you'll fail.
Keep the holder queue short — tap holders quickly!
Keep tapping before the queue overflows!
Four colors! Think before you tap.
Pick the holder with the most matching balloons first.
Strategy matters — clear the board for 3 stars!
Some balloons are hidden! Pop nearby balloons to reveal them.
Clear the visible balloons first to uncover hidden ones.
A spawner keeps producing balloons! Destroy it fast.
Target the spawner balloon directly to stop it!
A giant balloon needs multiple hits to pop!
Keep sending matching darts until the big one bursts!
Chain balloons explode together when one is popped!
Pop one chain balloon to clear the whole group at once!
Pop balloons in quick succession to build a combo!
Higher combos mean bonus score — go for 3 stars!
